The compare-answers pipeline is built and working: a chat question (chat_1) fans out to both llm_openai_1 (gpt-4o-mini) and llm_anthropic_1 (claude-sonnet-4-6), and response_1 merges both answers into a single reply back to the chat.

The test run has been terminated since chat sources wait indefinitely for input.

The pipeline is ready to use. Nothing is deployed or scheduled yet — let me know if you'd like it registered and put live on a team.
